description: Safe pre-alpha seed library: general/process/educational seeds only. No fake alpha, no public market claims.

seeds.audience: Macro-curious professionals and serious retail readers.
seeds.thesis_or_angle: A single data print is not a regime model.
seeds.title: Why one CPI print is not a forecast
key_points: A single data release rarely settles a macro thesis.
Revisions, base effects, and cross-asset confirmation all matter.
Observation, thesis, and actionable conclusion are different things.
limitations: Educational and general; not investment advice.

seeds.audience: Founders and builders who value evidence discipline.
seeds.thesis_or_angle: Build the refusal mode before the forecast.
seeds.title: Building review gates before we build a forecast
key_points: We wire guardrails and human review before any public output exists.
A serious research system needs a refusal mode.
Local-first and human-in-the-loop are deliberate choices.
limitations: Product and process commentary, not a market view.

seeds.audience: Readers who want to understand evidence thresholds.
seeds.thesis_or_angle: Missing stays missing; proxy is not official truth.
seeds.title: What has to be true before a forecast is worth drafting
key_points: Confidence is invalid if required inputs are absent.
Proxy-only data should be labeled, not hidden.
Forecast readiness is a gate, not a marketing badge.
limitations: General methodology discussion; no proprietary research output exists yet.

seeds.title: S&P 5000 buy signal before the rally
key_points: Our model says buy now and target a 12% gain.
